entries.text: 1. A son of Uzziel, helps carry the bodies of Nadab and Abihu out of the camp Ex 6:22; Le 10:4
2. A Jew who stood by Ezra when he read the law to the people Ne 8:4
One of three Hebrew young men trained with Daniel at the court of Babylon Da 1:6,7,11-20
Assists Daniel in interpreting Nebuchadnezzars dream Da 2:17-23
Thrown into the fiery furnace Da 3:13-30
